author: jvranek
content: following the ACDT call decision I dropped per-key, per-builder p2p bid preferences in favor of global per-key (note we still support per-key, per-builder for direct connections). The changes just required prose changes - types stay the same bc we now just stop overloading the `builder_pubkey` field. Biggest change was to the implementer guide, latest version [here](https://github.com/JasonVranek/epbs-config-flow/blob/4f21fd3dc04a7a8201b367d95f44f5c783c4fbd7/builder-config-flow.md). lot's of footguns removed 🙂
